"The project developed a machine-learning-based complaint classification system using passenger complaint data. Exploratory data analysis was first performed to understand the structure
"The complaint text was then converted into numerical features using TF-IDF
column2: and a Logistic Regression classification model was trained to predict complaint categories.\n"

column5: and a confusion matrix. A simple interface was also developed to allow users to enter new complaints and receive predicted categories.\n"
